name: Madison Eats
summary: Every place to eat in Dane County on one map, scored from six rating sources

shot.alt: Madison Eats: a grid of photo cards for restaurants, each with an overall score, its rank within its cuisine and a few highlights

hook: 2,292 places to eat in Dane County, scored from six rating sources, with the delivery apps that carry each one.
built: Python collectors, vanilla JS, Leaflet, Cloudflare Workers

notes: Photo cards, a map and a delivery-app tab, searchable in English or Chinese, with filters for cuisine, occasion and open now. Each place shows highlights such as its rank within its cuisine.
1,160 places can be ordered on at least one app: DoorDash 859, Uber Eats 817, Grubhub 539, EatStreet 274, Toast 182.

pages.title: How it works
notes: County food licences and OpenStreetMap give the base list. Collectors for six rating sources, county inspections and r/madisonwi are linked to it by name and address.

Sources grade on different curves (Toast averages 4.8 stars, EatStreet 4.0), so each rating becomes a percentile among Madison places on the same app, and places with few ratings are pulled toward the middle.
The public page carries no data. A Cloudflare Worker returns one page or one place at a time, behind a human check, daily quotas and a request log.
pages.caption: From collectors to the page.

pages.title: What the data says
notes: The sources agree only loosely. Rank correlations between pairs of sources run from 0.26 to 0.61 for the same places, and Uber Eats and Toast are uncorrelated. The score gives a source more weight when it agrees with the others.
Checked against a signal left out of the score, a random award winner outranks a random non-winner 66% of the time with the award bonus removed (168 winners).
pages.caption: Rank correlation of star ratings between pairs of sources, over the 2,292 places shown. n is the number of places rated on both.

blurb: every place to eat in Dane County, scored from six rating sources
